Countries 3D STL Models are high-resolution topographic 3D maps in STL format, created for 3D printing, CNC machining, laser engraving, and digital production. This category includes detailed 3D models of countries from around the world, accurately representing terrain relief, coastlines, and national land boundaries.

Each country STL model is based on real elevation data and optimized for manufacturing workflows. These files are ideal for educators, designers, architects, makers, engineers, and hobbyists who need precise, printable 3D country maps for physical or digital projects.

[/woodmart_text_block][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][woodmart_text_block woodmart_css_id="6970713c62a37" woodmart_inline="no" responsive_spacing="eyJwYXJhbV90eXBlIjoid29vZG1hcnRfcmVzcG9uc2l2ZV9zcGFjaW5nIiwic2VsZWN0b3JfaWQiOiI2OTcwNzEzYzYyYTM3Iiwic2hvcnRjb2RlIjoid29vZG1hcnRfdGV4dF9ibG9jayIsImRhdGEiOnsidGFibGV0Ijp7fSwibW9iaWxlIjp7fX19" parallax_scroll="no" wd_hide_on_desktop="no" wd_hide_on_tablet="no" wd_hide_on_mobile="no"]

What You’ll Find in This Category

In the Countries 3D Print & CNC Models section, you can download:

  • Europe country STL maps
  • Asia country 3D terrain models
  • North and South America country STL files
  • African country relief models
  • Australia and Oceania country STL maps

The collection includes large and small countries, islands, and regions, all delivered as instant digital downloads in STL format.

Key Features of Our Country STL Models

  • High-resolution topographic relief based on real geographic data
  • STL format compatible with all major 3D printers and CNC machines
  • Manufacturing-ready geometry with closed meshes
  • Easily scalable models for any print or milling size
  • Optimized for FDM, SLA, SLS printing, and CNC carving
[/woodmart_text_block][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][woodmart_text_block woodmart_css_id="697071a764705" woodmart_inline="no" responsive_spacing="eyJwYXJhbV90eXBlIjoid29vZG1hcnRfcmVzcG9uc2l2ZV9zcGFjaW5nIiwic2VsZWN0b3JfaWQiOiI2OTcwNzFhNzY0NzA1Iiwic2hvcnRjb2RlIjoid29vZG1hcnRfdGV4dF9ibG9jayIsImRhdGEiOnsidGFibGV0Ijp7fSwibW9iaWxlIjp7fX19" parallax_scroll="no" wd_hide_on_desktop="no" wd_hide_on_tablet="no" wd_hide_on_mobile="no"]

Use Cases

  • 3D printed maps of countries
  • CNC-carved wooden or metal country maps
  • Educational geography models
  • Interior decor and wall installations
  • Prototyping and visualization
  • Creative and artistic terrain projects
[/woodmart_text_block][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][woodmart_text_block woodmart_css_id="697071c150f63" woodmart_inline="no" responsive_spacing="eyJwYXJhbV90eXBlIjoid29vZG1hcnRfcmVzcG9uc2l2ZV9zcGFjaW5nIiwic2VsZWN0b3JfaWQiOiI2OTcwNzFjMTUwZjYzIiwic2hvcnRjb2RlIjoid29vZG1hcnRfdGV4dF9ibG9jayIsImRhdGEiOnsidGFibGV0Ijp7fSwibW9iaWxlIjp7fX19" parallax_scroll="no" wd_hide_on_desktop="no" wd_hide_on_tablet="no" wd_hide_on_mobile="no"]

Customization & Professional Use

All country STL models can be modified in any STL-compatible software. You may adjust scale, height exaggeration, base thickness, or merge multiple countries into a single map. Custom projections, resolutions, or specific regions are available upon request.

Browse the Countries 3D STL Models category and download professional-grade terrain files designed for 3D printing and CNC machining.
